Bookclub 010 · Rotterdam · 2025
The moment it clicked

How I learned what
presence really does

"People showed up as strangers. They read together in silence and started connecting as though they'd known each other for years."

In December 2023 I did a full digital detox for a year. What opened up in that space changed how I see everything. More creativity. More depth. And a kind of connection I hadn't realised I'd been craving.

From that place, I co-created Bookclub 010, a silent reading community in Rotterdam. A weekly gathering in the heart of the city that brought book lovers, introverts and Rotterdammers of all walks of life together. The concept sounds simple. The experience was something else entirely. People showed up as strangers, read together in silence, then started connecting as though they'd known each other for years. Nobody reached for their phone. Nobody wanted to go home. Because of the space we designed for them to feel safe enough to be truly present in.

That's what I've been designing ever since. Not just events, but spaces where people feel something real. Where presence and connection are the foundation of a growing community.

About Yasmin

Creative Director.
Event Strategist.
From Rotterdam, with love.

I'm Yasmin, and what I care about most is creating spaces where people feel genuinely present. Not just physically in the room, but actually there: connected, open, alive to what's happening around them.

My Javanese and Surinamese roots gave me a deep understanding of what it means to truly gather. The warmth, intention and presence that come from the people and the energy in a space are the things that make a room feel different from the moment people walk in.

I've spent years building events for founders, corporates, startup communities and intimate circles. But what changed my approach fully was doing a digital detox in 2023 for a year. What I found in that intentional space quietly became the foundation for everything I build now. And in all of it, the thing that matters most is never the programme. It's the quality of presence in the room.

I work best with people who feel that too. Who want to create something that goes deeper than an agenda. Who are building for their city, their community, their people and want the event to actually reflect that.

How we can work together

Three ways I show up
for your vision

See all the ways we can work together →
01
Creative Direction & Full Event Management

From the first creative conversation to the final moment of the evening, I hold the vision and the logistics together. Concept, vendor coordination, run-of-show, day-of management. Everything taken care of, so you can actually be present at your own event.

Purpose-driven events · Founder gatherings · Launches · Institutional events
02
Strategy & Consulting Session

A standalone 60-minute paid session where we go back to the core: your mission, your audience, your vision, and translate it into something tangible. You bring your questions. We build the plan together. You leave with clear direction and real next steps.

Single session · Mission-to-event translation · Actionable output
03
Brand Storytelling & Videography

Your mission deserves to be seen. I create brand storytelling films that bring your vision and values to life in visual form, capturing not just what you do, but why it matters and the people at the heart of it.

Mission films · Brand storytelling · Visual narrative

How it works

Simple, clear, together

01
You share what you're building

A moment to get to know not only what you're creating, but also the person or organisation behind the vision. What is your story, and what drives you to bring it to life? This helps us both understand what this gathering truly wants to be.

02
We shape the vision together

I translate what you've shared into a clear picture: the creative direction, the format, the experience design, the feel. For the first time, you see it whole. That moment of clarity is where the real work begins.

03
We agree on how I can help

Full creative direction and event management, a single deep-dive session or a branding video. Together we find the shape that fits where you are and what you actually need right now.

04
Something real comes to life

The experience comes to life. The space of presence is created and connections are able to be formed.
